overall.verdict: A confident, trust-first dark fintech UI: the one-absolute-scale bars, the enforceable-vs-promised split, signed-frame proofs, evidence bundles and dispute windows genuinely make safety legible and are a real differentiator. It is dragged by unfinished microcopy (the factual '100 bp = 100%' error, 'Show 1empty', 'www on-chain'), very dense operator screens, and first-timer barriers in the collateral/credit jargon and the testnet faucet mixing.
priority_fixes: Fix the '100 bp = 100%' error and all unfinished/typo microcopy ('Show 1empty', 'www on-chain') — single largest credibility hit and cheap
Turn the Swap 'prepare incoming capacity' warning into a guided, prominent add-collateral step and show slippage vs limit plainly (unblocks Maya and Anya)
Convert the Pay/Swap capacity math into a plain 'you have X, you'll have Y after' with one explanation line
Simplify the Desk/operator table with sortable columns, tooltips, and a corrected 'What's on-chain' card (helps Marcus and stops overwhelming Dmitri)
Add plain-English inline explainers for the core terms (credit line, collateral, hub promise, at-risk, lazy entity) across Home, Account, Ownership and Sovereignty
